LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT 1976

CREMATORIUM (FEDERAL TERRITORY OF PUTRAJAYA) BY-LAWS 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 98 of the Local Government Act 1976

[Act 171], as modified by the Federal Territory of Putrajaya (Modification of Local

Government Act 1976) Order 2002 [P.U. (A) 142/2002], the Perbadanan Putrajaya

makes and pursuant to section 103 of the said Act, the Minister confirms the following

by-laws:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These by-laws may be cited as the Crematorium (Federal Territory of

Putrajaya) By-Laws 2012.

(2) These By-Laws shall come into operation on 1 August 2012.

Application

2. These By-Laws shall apply only to the Federal Territory of Putrajaya.

Interpretation

3. In these By-Laws, unless the context otherwise requires—

"crematorium" means the crematorium provided by the Perbadanan under

subsection 94(1) of the Local Government Act 1976;

"person in charge of the crematorium" means any person who has been

appointed by the Perbadanan to manage the affairs of the crematorium; and

"Perbadanan" means the Perbadanan Putrajaya established under section 3 of

the Perbadanan Putrajaya Act 1995 [Act 536].

Application and fee

4. (1) No cremation at the crematorium shall be permitted unless an application

is made in such form as the Perbadanan may provide for the purpose.

(2) The application shall be made by any of the following persons:

(a) next-of-kin of the deceased person;

(b) a person who is authorized in writing to make the application by

the next-of-kin of the deceased person;

(c) the lawful personal representative of the deceased person;

(d) any close relative of the deceased person;

(e) any person who has obtained a permit to bury from the police or

hospital authority;

(f) any other persons who satisfy the Perbadanan as to the reason

why the application is not made by the persons referred to in

paragraphs (a) and (b).

(3) The Perbadanan may approve the application made under paragraph 2

subject to—

(a) payment of a fee as prescribed in the Schedule; and

(b) any condition and restriction as the Perbadanan may specify.

Prohibition against cremation

5. (1) No cremation of any deceased person shall be permitted at the

crematorium—

(a) if it is known, believed, or suspected that the deceased person was

a Muslim;

(b) if there is doubt as to whether the deceased person was a Muslim;

(c) if it is known that the deceased person had given any direction or

indication, whether verbally or in writing, that his body should

not be cremated or buried; or

(d) if the identity of the deceased person has not been ascertained.

(2) No cremation of any deceased person shall be permitted at the

crematorium until it is produced to the person in charge of the crematorium a permit to

bury lawfully issued by the police or hospital authority in respect of the deceased

person.

Time for cremation

6. (1) The crematorium shall be available for the cremation of corpse on the day

and at the time as prescribed in the Schedule.

(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), the Perbadanan may in any particular

case permit cremation to be carried out at the crematorium at any time other than the

time prescribed in the Schedule.

Specification of coffin

7. A coffin used for containing any corpse to be cremated at the crematorium shall

be made of wood according to the specification as the Perbadanan may determine.

Disposal of ashes

8. (1) After every cremation, the ashes of the deceased person shall be

surrendered to the person who applied for the cremation, if he claims them.

(2) If, within fourteen days after notice has been given to the person who

applied for the cremation to collect the ashes, he has not done so or if he has indicated

that he does not wish to claim them, the ashes shall be interred or scattered at such

place as the Perbadanan may determine.

(3) While the ashes of the deceased person remain at the crematorium, they

shall be properly stored and so marked or placed as to be clearly identified.

Register of cremation

9. (1) The person in charge of the crematorium shall keep or cause to be kept a

register of cremation which shall be in such form as the Perbadanan may prescribe and

in which shall be entered the following particulars relating to each cremation:

(a) the serial number of the cremation;

(b) the date of the cremation;

(c) the name, identity card number, residential address, occupation,

age, sex, religion and marital status of the deceased person;

(d) the date, place and time of death of the deceased person;

(e) the name, identity card number and address of the person who

applied for the cremation;

(f) relationship between the person who applied for the cremation

with the deceased person;

(g) the cause of death of the deceased person, if known;

(h) the reference number of the permit to bury;

(i) the name, designation and address of the person who issued the

permit to bury;

(j) the manner in which the ashes of the deceased person were

disposed of.

(2) The particulars referred to in subparagraphs 1(a) to (i), shall be entered

in the register of cremation immediately after the cremation has taken place and the

particulars referred to in subparagraph 1(j) shall be entered as soon as the ashes have

been disposed of under these By-Laws.

Keeping of records

10. (1) The person in charge of the crematorium shall ensure that all

applications, permits and other documents relating to each cremation are numbered,

properly filed and carefully kept for a period of seven years from the date of the

cremation.

(2) The register of cremation or any part of the register of cremation shall not

be destroyed.

Exemption

11. The Perbadanan may conditionally or unconditionally exempt any person from

any provision of these By-Laws.

Revocation

12. The Crematorium (Perbadanan Putrajaya) By-Laws 1999 [Sel. P.U. 47/1999] is

revoked.

Savings

14. Any application, permit, register or document made, issued or kept under the

revoked By-Laws shall be deemed to have been made, issued or kept under these ByLaws, and shall continue in force until revoked or replaced under these By-Laws.
